_readme: UNVERIFIED Cursor prompt-time context injection for @walmart/ld-kit.
NOT shipped active, for two reasons:
1. .cursor/hooks.json is a "version": 1 schema. An unrecognised event key
risks a config-parse failure that would ALSO take down the working
`stop` a11y hook already in that file. Losing a working loop to enable
an unproven one is a bad trade.
2. The only Cursor facts verified in this repo are the `stop` event and
its stdout {followup_message} transport (see scripts/a11y/README.md).
Neither the event name below nor whether its stdout reaches the model's
context has been confirmed.
Cursor is also the runtime that needs this least: the .mdc frontmatter
(alwaysApply / globs) auto-attach actually works there, so rules already
reach the model without a hook.
TO TRY IT:
1. Merge the `hooks` block below into .cursor/hooks.json.
2. Set LD_CURSOR_PROMPT_HOOK=1 — scripts/ld/hook.mjs detects Cursor (via
the cursor_version field Cursor puts in the hook payload) and emits
NOTHING unless that flag is set. This is on purpose: Cursor also reads
.claude/settings.json, so the Claude hook can fire under Cursor, and
sending a payload whose transport we are guessing at is worse than
staying quiet.
3. Restart Cursor and confirm BOTH that this hook fires AND that the a11y
`stop` hook still does. If either breaks, revert — you lose nothing.
Kill switch, as everywhere: LD_CONTEXT_OFF=1.

beforeSubmitPrompt.command: test -f scripts/ld/hook.mjs && node scripts/ld/hook.mjs --agent cursor || true
